biblStruct.note: An edition of the anonymous reworking of Yefet b. Eli’s Judaeo-Arabic translation of Obadiah, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum in MS: Oxford, Bodleian Libraries, Hunt. 206—of which Friedmann utilized a copy in the Budapest Rabbinic Seminary. On the later identification of this Ms. with Yefet’s work see, inter alios, P. Birnbaum’s 1942 edition of Yefet on Hosea https://biblia-arabica.com/bibl/34RLRYC5 and E. Schlossberg’s 2000 Pe‘amim article https://biblia-arabica.com/bibl/NY3EPQ72. (Biblia Arabica)
